verdicts.note: Interim incumbent appointed unanimously [S3], with in-office volunteer work from 'mopping floors' to autopsies and budget meetings and a lead-microbiologist background [S4] (verified). Weeks of tenure keep it at -1/medium.

+2 ('maximal outsider/renewal case') at high confidence is overstated. He has held no public office [S1][S4] and argues character over death-investigation experience [S3][S4], which supports the renewal side. But he does not campaign on new voices or generational change: he rests his case on decades of private-sector administrative and budget experience [S1][S9] and told the forum 'we both came out of the gate with the same qualifications' and that Lathum 'has got ahead of me' on coroner education [S9] (verified in the cached article). The basis's 'repeatedly argues' rests on one quote that appears on two campaign pages [S3][S4]. +1/medium fits.
